channel.title: Signal
channel.description: Tech news matched to Patrick's interests, curated daily.

item.title: DXC and LangChain partner on governed agentic AI for mission-critical IT
item.description: DXC Technology partners with LangChain to build governed agent harnesses on the LangGraph runtime and LangSmith tooling for mission-critical IT operations; DXC says its OASIS platform, already in production, cut incident resolution time 95% across 500 measured use cases.

item.title: Xcode 26.3 RC brings agentic coding to the IDE: Claude Agent and Codex integrated via MCP
item.description: Apple's Xcode 26.3 release candidate adds built-in agentic coding, with Anthropic's Claude Agent, OpenAI's Codex, and custom agents via MCP able to read and modify project files, build apps, and run tests directly in the IDE.

item.title: Cognitum One releases Ruflo, open-source agent meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex
item.description: Open-source meta-harness for Claude Code and Codex that organizes agents into queen-led swarms with persistent shared memory, plus mission-driven Mods and a single control plane; the release claims 74,000 GitHub stars and 12.5M npm downloads.

item.title: Deploying LLMs locally: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM and TGI compared
item.description: Fresh hands-on walkthrough covering all four runtimes end to end: Ollama quick-start, llama.cpp builds and Q4_K_M quantization, vLLM serving with AWQ/GPTQ and LoRA adapters, plus TGI, with runnable configs for each.

item.title: Blizzard rules out adding existing expansion races to WoW: Forever
item.description: Blizzard tells TechRadar it has no plans to bring goblin, vulpera, or haranir races to WoW: Forever, instead building an independent timeline off the Warcraft III Reforged: Forsaken Kingdom campaign — with the all-new Skyborne race as the sole exception.

item.title: Agentic AI roundup: Google open-sources self-improving agent harness RRSI
item.description: Google Research open-sources RRSI, a framework that lets LLM agents rewrite their own prompts, tools, and memory — Terminal-Bench 2.1 rises from 74.2% to 80.2%; also notes a 115 ms local routing model for agent tool-selection on an RTX 3090.

item.title: WoW: Forever class design: no modernization, just 'engaging depth'
item.description: Blizzard tells TechRadar it won't modernize WoW: Forever's classes, but some 'too simple' vanilla classes get new mechanics — judged against the four design pillars behind its Classic Plus identity.

item.title: WoW: Forever beta is already breaking records; Blizzard won't cater to the loudest fans
item.description: At PAX Australia, Blizzard called the Forever beta its biggest ever and set expectations: horizontal growth, broad-feedback-driven decisions, no Italian client yet.

item.title: WoW: Forever is official: Blizzard's season-free Classic launches November 4
item.description: Blizzard dates the permanent Classic realm for November 4: slower progression, manual groups, limited finders and add-ons, framed as a long-term home rather than another season.

item.title: Rapid-MLX: open-source inference server for Apple Silicon with dual OpenAI/Anthropic APIs
item.description: New Apache-2.0 MLX-based server speaks both OpenAI and Anthropic API formats, aimed at reliable tool calling for locally run coding agents.

item.title: WoW: Forever gets SD Skyborne models in early 2027
item.description: After beta feedback on the HD Skyborne models, Blizzard is retouching Skyborne druid forms to match Classic's visual language now and promises a lower-detail SD model option in early 2027.

item.title: On-device LLM research (2026-10-09): MediaPipe/LiteRT vs Gemini Nano on mid-range Android phones
item.description: Dated research note comparing MediaPipe/LiteRT (Gemma 4 E2B, Gemma 3n, Phi-3 Mini) against Gemini Nano via AICore: model sizes, RAM floors, tok/s, and context limits for real Android hardware.

item.title: Fantasy Grounds Acquires Eldritch Foundry: VTT Meets 3D Minis
item.description: SmiteWorks bought Eldritch Foundry's 3D character-builder assets to push Fantasy Grounds toward 3D minis, with the founder's team staying on as consultants.

item.title: OutSystems Agent Experience reaches GA for any coding agent
item.description: Enterprise platform opens its governed development environment to Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Kiro, enforcing system design, security guardrails and lifecycle management around whatever agent developers use.

item.title: Harness acquires Augment Code assets, launches Cosmos software-factory agent
item.description: Harness bought Augment Code's Cosmos and Auggie CLI assets and Code Context Engine, folding its ticket-to-PR agent fleet into Harness's autonomous SDLC platform.

item.title: WoW Forever beta: ~4,000 RMT accounts banned
item.description: Blizzard confirmed nearly 4,000 account closures on the WoW Forever beta for real-money trading — over 2,100 gold buyers and ~1,600 sellers/bots — and is adding a UI warning against untrustworthy trades.

item.title: Blizzard lays out its Classic Plus design pillars for WoW Forever
item.description: The WoW: Forever team named its four design pillars - social experiences, approachable and familiar, world as the main character, journey before destination - and described balancing modern visuals against the vanilla look.

item.title: Dungeon XP Was Bugged in WoW Forever — Blizzard's Fix + Dev Podcast Breakdown
item.description: Creator rundown of Blizzard's beta dungeon-XP fix: kill XP was tied to the highest-level group member, plus a 20% dungeon kill-XP boost and highlights from the third dev podcast.

item.title: LLM Weight + Activation Quantization: Frontier Report 2023-2026
item.description: Fresh report gathering falsifiable quantization claims — GPTQ/AWQ/GGUF k-quants, FP8/MXFP8, SmoothQuant, SpQR, and 2-bit methods — with live-checkable citations, aimed at kernel builders.

item.title: Superfluid: open-source local LLM server built for multi-agent workloads
item.description: Apache-2.0 server running LLMs on your own machine across llama.cpp, MLX, and BaseRT runtimes, with request prioritization so interactive chat preempts background agents, session persistence, and multi-device inference over an encrypted link.

item.title: Blizzard's original plan for WoW: Forever was much smaller than what it's launching
item.description: Exec producer Stone says the first Forever pitch was vanilla with light class tweaks, but it ballooned after Season of Discovery's reception: 1,000+ new quests, nine dungeons, two raids, and a new 15v15 battleground ahead of the November 4 launch.

item.title: Termux Assistant AI: giving an LLM shell hands inside Android
item.description: Open-source MIT project bridges a WebView chat app to Termux over local HTTP so the model can run shell commands and build things on the phone.

item.title: Cisco unveils Webex Dialog agentic harness at WebexOne
item.description: Cisco previewed Webex Dialog, an agentic harness layer for its Webex AI Agent platform meant to keep customer work running across people, agents and backend systems after a chat ends; beta is slated for Q1 2027.

item.title: Windows ML Gets llama.cpp: Run GGUF Locally on Any Hardware
item.description: Microsoft folded llama.cpp into Windows ML, adding NPU routing (QNN, OpenVINO, TensorRT RTX) for any GGUF — and pushed CUDA kernel, speculative-decoding and multi-GPU optimizations back upstream.

item.title: Top 5 Local LLM Tools and Models in 2026
item.description: A fresh roundup of the year's standout local setups, from GPT-OSS 20B/120B and DeepSeek V3.2-Exp to runners like LocalAI, Jan, and Ollama.

item.title: Blizzard Warns WoW: Forever Gold Buyers: RMT 'Not Worth Putting Your Account at Risk'
item.description: After nearly 4,000 beta account closures, Blizzard tells WoW: Forever players it's watching gold buying closely and will escalate penalties up to permanent bans.

item.title: Magnitude: open-source inference engine claiming 92% faster decode than llama.cpp on Apple Silicon
item.description: YC-backed Apache-2.0 local engine that compiles and tunes kernels on the target machine instead of shipping generic ones; team claims 92% faster decode than llama.cpp on an M4 Pro Mac and 19% on NVIDIA, with a shared prefix cache for multi-agent setups. Released September 30 and hit 6,400 GitHub stars within days.

item.title: Termux-BitNet v2.0.1: mobile GPU memory slicing for 1.58-bit on-device inference
item.description: Release adds vocab-slice and chunked layer dispatch to fit 1.58-bit LLM inference into mobile GPU limits, plus watchdog-timeout fixes for Mali GPUs.

item.title: AgentEng launched: CLI, MCP, A2A and ACP support for agentic AI events
item.description: Agent Engineering HQ released AgentEng, an open-source companion providing a Python CLI, MCP server, A2A service and experimental ACP client so coding assistants and other agents can query its conference programme and tooling.

item.title: RuneScape 4 revealed: Unreal Engine MMO from Jagex
item.description: Jagex announced RuneScape 4 at RuneFest: a standalone Unreal Engine MMO set in the Sixth Age, pivoted from a Dragonwilds survival expansion into a full classic-format MMO.

item.title: Fable keeps combat accessible with hidden complexity
item.description: Playground Games on Fable's combat: accessible but with hidden depth — targeted body-part shots that change enemy behavior, plus non-combat quest paths via dialogue, reputation, and puzzles.

item.title: Reflection's Beam: open-weight model for lower-compute AI
item.description: Reflection's new open-weight model pitches cheaper local fine-tuning and inference for teams keeping data on-premise — the 'sovereign AI factory' angle.

item.title: llama.cpp vs Ollama in 2026
item.description: Same engine under both, so measured speed gaps trace to quant choice, flash-attention and KV-cache-quant flags, and how fast Ollama merges upstream llama.cpp.

item.title: WoW Forever FAQ: release, zones, and what's new vs Classic
item.description: A concise explainer framing Forever as a re-envisioning rather than a remaster: new zones like Mount Hyjal and the Riverglades, overhauled classic areas, and the design logic of changing content instead of faithfully recreating it.

item.title: Google Launches EmbeddingGemma 2, a Small Open Multimodal Embedding Model for On-Device Search
item.description: Google DeepMind's 740M-param open embedding model maps text, code, images, video, and audio into one space for on-device multimodal search and local RAG.

item.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: lightweight agentic RL framework that trains agents in their real harness
item.description: Microsoft Research Asia rebuilt Agent Lightning as a ~3,500-line RL control plane where the deployed harness participates in training; its coding pipeline lifted Qwen3.5-9B from 41.8% to 56.4% Pass@1 on SWE-bench Verified with about 6,000 samples.

item.title: WoW Forever Reputation Changes | How Old and New Factions Expand Progression?
item.description: Rundown of WoW Forever's endgame roadmap: first raids (Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit, Onyxia's Lair) unlock December 9, 2026, with the Forever Hardcore ruleset planned for winter 2026/27.

item.title: WoW Forever sticks with classic models after beta feedback
item.description: Blizzard backed off HD-only character models in the WoW Forever beta after tester pushback, keeping the classic look — and reverted a modern-looking quilboar boss to its original form.

item.title: Coding agent news: OpenAI DevDay refresh, Gemini sandboxes, Claude coding releases (week ending Oct 6)
item.description: Roundup of the week's agentic-coding moves: computer-use in the Agents API, a refreshed Codex CLI, Gemini's GA sandboxes, and new Anthropic coding releases.

item.title: AirLLM + RLM: self-contained local inference stack
item.description: Open-source stack pairing AirLLM's layer-streamed inference with a Rust RLM harness: two-tier GGUF serving, recursive long-context navigation, and a single OpenAI-compatible API.
